description: Find brands similar to a given brand by category, price tier, and competition level. Use when the user asks 'brands like Nike', 'similar brands to source', 'show me comparable brands', 'what else is in this niche', or any cohort/lookalike question.

brand_contains.description: Only keep similar brands whose name contains this substring.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

min_seller_count.description: Only similar brands with at least this many unique sellers (3m).

name: brand_similar
